reviews.comment: Dr. McDougall is by far one of the best professors I have had at A&M. She cares about her students, listens to our concerns, and makes changes in the schedule if she believes it will benefit us. Yes the class is hard, but she explains the concepts clearly, highlights what's important, and provides extra material to help you study. I love her dearly
This professor does not understand how to teach. No one understands what goes on. She puts on a facade that she cares about you as a human but she does not.

Dr. McDougall teaches a very tough class but makes it very accessible to people who may not be as interested in the topics covered. As someone with a biomaterials background, the idea of a medical imaging class was a total nightmare, but Dr. McDougall made it very accessible and understandable.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. McDougall will without a doubt be one of the top professors I will have taken in my college career. She genuinely cares about each one of her students (probably more than any other professor I've had) and assigns work fairly. I cannot say enough good things about her as a person and a professor.
